hard_invariant.note: The 9-slot fixed HOTBAR, the 9-wide action `slot` branch, and the 73-dim obs (which loops over HOTBAR) are mutually locked to the canonical checkpoint's input layer. Only items present in HOTBAR are policy-selectable/usable. Adding a new hotbar item changes obs (73 -> 74+) and action (slot 9 -> 10+) and INVALIDATES the 73-dim canonical checkpoint.

verdict: Ranged (bow) is the one major new skill that is both mechanically wired AND scenario-provable without breaking the obs/action/checkpoint invariant. It is built, scripted-proven, gated, and scheduled in the 168h controller. Crossbow/water/lava/extra-potions are blocked by the 9-slot hotbar + 73-dim obs + canonical-checkpoint invariant and were NOT forced (would violate the preserve-architecture hard rules).
